audio.text: I've been working on a case that I haven't been able to track. It had taken me blood, sweat, and tears by the time I found our first clue. Developing an investigation requires cunning skill and of course tons of patience. To get a clue is not as simple as to make it look on TV, since along with it, you have to keep up with all the paperwork that as a detective you have to fill in. So it means burning a candle at both ends. If I weren't having a meeting tonight with an informant, I would have gone mad already. It's been two weeks since the murder and we have just a note the killer left. She deserved it. If he hadn't left that, we would have nothing, but still we have nothing. I'm hoping I could get the most out of the meeting I'm having with him tonight.

audio.text: What people normally want in life is exactly what they don't know. Knowing exactly what you want sometimes can be really tricky, especially if you're going through a crisis. If I had had a clear idea of what I wanted and where I wanted to go, it would have been a lot easier for me when I was younger. Nevertheless, I think that having this type of crisis in your life makes you stronger, once you've overcome them. Developing skills does not only require dedication, but sometimes they come from hardships. You live and teach you some things you would never learn by listening to others' experiences. To be a grown-up has never been only a matter of age, but something that comes with the different moments lived in life.
